worked_solution:
To find the $y$-intercepts of the hyperbola, we substitute $x=0$ into the equation of the hyperbola and solve for $y,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{(y-1)^{2}}{4}-\frac{{x}^{2}}{9} & =1 \\ \frac{(y-1)^{2}}{4}-\frac{(0)^{2}}{9} & =1 \\ \frac{(y-1)^{2}}{4} & =1 \\ (y-1)^{2} & =4 \\ y-1 & =\pm 2 \\ y & =-1,3\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the $y$-intercepts are $(0,-1)$ and $(0,3).$
